name: Salt Shack

evidence.note: Review describes local bands and dancing under the stars at the beach venue.
Guest comment: great bands to sing and dance with.
Review mentions staying for the live music and having fun dancing.
Official calendar: Southern Earth Experience Sat Oct 3 7 pm; Pumpkin Festival 12-4 pm and The Byrne Unit 5 pm on Sun Oct 4.

dancing.notes: People dance on the sand and main floor in front of the stage when bands and DJs play. It can get very crowded on big nights.

description: A seasonal beach bar and grill right on the sand at Cedar Beach on Ocean Parkway, with a stage for bands, DJs, picnic tables and an upstairs deck.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Official site says the season is May-September, but it still lists October events. Ira listed Byrne Unit at '3p?' while the venue calendar says 5 pm on Oct 4. Some listings give 1 or 200 Ocean Pkwy; the official site says 100 Ocean Pkwy. Cedar Beach parking may cost non-residents a fee. Ira's List has a venue page (/salt-shack-2021).

Directory research 2026-10-04: Hours on the site say it is closed Mon-Thu for the rest of the 2026 season; a weather banner also said it would close early on the day checked. Bing lists the address as 200 Ocean Pkwy; the venue's own site says 100 Ocean Pkwy, which is kept. Two emails appear only as hidden contact-form recipients (one a named staff member), so no public email was recorded; there is a separate catering line (631) 317-9313 on an older listing, not on the current site. Several photos on the site's Specials/Contact pages are generic stock images, so they were skipped. The Town of Babylon charges a parking fee before 4 PM.
hours: Fri 4 PM-11 PM; Sat 11 AM-11 PM; Sun 11 AM-9 PM; closed Mon-Thu for the rest of the 2026 season (open May-September)

logo.alt: Salt Shack Seaside Grill logo in light blue rough lettering with a surfboard between the two words

photos.alt: Aerial view of the Salt Shack on Cedar Beach: a teal beach bar with a blue roof, upper deck and palm trees over rows of tables on the sand, with the bay behind
Tables and chairs set out on the sand under palm trees and string lights, in front of the teal Salt Shack building and its covered upper deck

evidence.note: Venue's own Find Us page: 100 Ocean Pkwy, Babylon, NY 11702, (631) 422-7222, current hours, free parking after 4 PM, and links to its Facebook and Instagram.
Home page says it is on Cedar Beach, open May-September, with live bands and DJs most days; it still lists October 2026 band dates.
Event calendar lists upcoming bands (The Byrne Unit Oct 4 at 5 PM, Decadia, The Legendary Murphys, Kung Fu Betty).
